(R) Every spot inside the scene is the fork's generated layout, not an original one. Zone number 1200 is the fork's; ours must be assigned and the scene sg_random_encounter_clearing has not been loaded by our server yet (the eleven shipped battles all use sg_random_encounter_clearing). Knockouts and score are the design's defaults; coins and XP are the shipped battles' values, not the fork's 15 coins / 100 stars.

(R) Not proven in the client: this scene needs one native load, and the starter or door of `entry` is drawn by the entrances work, not by this file. Each kind's rank here decides its health and hit at the fight's tier.
